name: belay
description: Belay - proof-carrying agents for the post-code lifecycle on GitLab. Set up eight agents, watch every one, and take autonomy back with one click.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:structure && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:structure: node scripts/check-structure.mjs src && node scripts/check-structure.mjs engine && node scripts/check-structure.mjs runner && node scripts/check-structure.mjs cli && node scripts/check-structure.mjs scripts
